style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), early-1900s American clothes. Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges, seals, flags, readable text or numbers, guns pointed at people, blood, wounds, faces resembling real people
